name: App Scan Hero
description: Centered dark product hero: a spinning atom mark, a mono delivery badge, an oversized heading with an inline brand tile, dual CTAs, three feature tabs above a sweeping progress line, and a Mac-window mockup where a scan bar sweeps a circuit-node board over a glowing app icon and flags a security warning.
interactions: atom mark spins 8s linear infinite (keyframe wpmn-ash-spin)
tab progress line sweeps left-right 4s ease-in-out infinite (62%-wide gradient, keyframe wpmn-ash-sweep)
window scan bar sweeps the board: translate(-50%,-213px) -> (-50%,400px) at 0% / 70-100%, 5s ease-out infinite (keyframe wpmn-ash-scan)
primary CTA enable/hovered/pressed, dark CTA fill 4%->10%, both press down 1px (120-200ms)
container-keyed responsive via ResizeObserver: toggles is-narrow (<820px, hides tab descriptions) and is-xs (<560px, hides menu items and wraps the warning)
prefers-reduced-motion: spin/sweep/scan off (scan parked mid-window), CTA transitions off
